'''Tim Jones''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Atlanta DPC]] on 28 July 2001 with Tatooine Liberation mains, according to Matt Mathison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2816">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-furry-and-furious-at-the-atlanta-dpcd2816/ furry-and-furious-at-the-atlanta-dpc], DeckTech (Matt "Furry Fury" Mathison, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-furry-and-furious-at-the-atlanta-dpcd2816/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
